sentences.zh: 欢迎收听新一期节目，今天我们将剖析二十多岁时的心理状态。

sentences.en: I'm really excited for this episode.
sentences.zh: 我非常期待这一期节目。

sentences.en: I think that the emotion we're speaking about today is one that we don't talk about enough.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们今天讨论的情感，是我们平时谈论得还不够多的。

sentences.en: And what I really want to explore is the psychology behind guilt, particularly chronic guilt or feelings of guilt for things that we haven't done
sentences.zh: 我真正想探讨的是内疚背后的心理学，特别是长期内疚，或者为我们没有做过的事情感到内疚，

sentences.en: or holding, carrying an emotional burden that we don't deserve to.
sentences.zh: 或者背负着我们本不该承担的情感包袱。

sentences.en: It is such a common experience, I think, particularly amongst people in this generation to feel this lingering feeling that we have done something wrong,
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常普遍的体验，我认为尤其是在我们这一代人当中，会有一种挥之不去的错觉，觉得我们做错了什么，

sentences.en: even when there's no evidence for it, or that someone is secretly mad at you, that you are a monster.
sentences.zh: 即使根本没有任何证据，或者觉得别人在暗中生你的气，觉得自己是个怪物。

sentences.en: Here is a spoiler.
sentences.zh: 这里先剧透一下。

sentences.en: You are not a monster.
sentences.zh: 你不是怪物。

sentences.en: You have just been conditioned into believing that you are responsible for other people's emotions.
sentences.zh: 你只是被潜移默化地灌输了一种观念，认为你必须对其他人的情绪负责。

sentences.en: This is a concept known as the guilt complex.
sentences.zh: 这个概念被称为内疚情结。

sentences.en: Intense and frequent feelings of guilt that aren't associated or connected to any event in particular.
sentences.zh: 即强烈而频繁的内疚感，但这些内疚感与任何具体事件都没有关联。

sentences.en: Guilt is so interesting to me because it's such an intricate emotion and a lot of psychologists still don't really understand it that well.
sentences.zh: 内疚对我来说非常有趣，因为它是一种极其复杂的情感，许多心理学家至今仍未能完全理解它。

sentences.en: We don't really know where it comes from, why it occurs.
sentences.zh: 我们并不真正知道它从何而来，为什么会出现。

sentences.en: Obviously, there is this very traditional idea of guilt, this very severe sense of guilt that is associated with committing a crime or doing something horrific
sentences.zh: 显然，有一种非常传统的内疚观念，即与犯罪、做可怕的事情

sentences.en: or something that you deeply regret.
sentences.zh: 或让你深感后悔的事情相关的严重罪恶感。

sentences.en: And of course, this kind of guilt does exist, this sense of blame for the harm that you've caused others,
sentences.zh: 当然，这种内疚感确实存在，即对你给他人造成的伤害感到自责，

sentences.en: but I don't really think it's the kind of guilt that most of us in our 20s
sentences.zh: 但我并不认为这是我们大多数二十多岁的人

sentences.en: are actually experiencing.
sentences.zh: 真正在经历的内疚。

sentences.en: This kind of guilt, where we commit a crime, we do something bad, it's called reactive guilt.
sentences.zh: 这种因为犯罪或做了坏事而产生的内疚，被称为反应性内疚。

sentences.en: But we can also just have guilty thoughts, which we never intend to act on, but they kind of sit in our brain and fester and convince us that we are evil.
sentences.zh: 但我们也会产生一些内疚的想法，我们从未打算付诸行动，但它们却在我们的脑海里挥之不去、不断恶化，让我们确信自己是个坏人。

sentences.en: We also just feel a real general guilt about the injustices in the world, existential guilt, because we feel responsible for other people's suffering.
sentences.zh: 我们还会对世界上的不公产生一种普遍的内疚感，也就是存在主义内疚，因为我们觉得自己对别人的痛苦负有责任。

sentences.en: But I think the kind of guilt that we mostly experience is guilt towards things we haven't done or are yet to do.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们主要经历的内疚，是对那些我们没有做过或者尚未做的事情的内疚。

sentences.en: Guilt around upsetting people or displaced guilt, feeling that sense of shame or accountability for another person's emotions or for choosing to behave
sentences.zh: 因为惹恼别人而产生的内疚，或者移置性内疚——为别人的情绪感到羞愧或自责，或者因为选择了一种

sentences.en: in a way that is completely justified but might upset other people.
sentences.zh: 完全正当但可能会惹恼别人的行为方式而感到内疚。

sentences.en: This has become a lot more common and I think relatable for people in their 20s, especially because there's this very deep philosophy around not only just being a good person,
sentences.zh: 这在二十多岁的人当中变得越来越普遍，也更能引发共鸣，特别是因为这里有一种深层的理念：不仅要做一个好人，

sentences.en: but also treating this decade with a certain like distinctiveness, a certain romance.
sentences.zh: 还要以某种独特的方式、某种浪漫的眼光来对待这个十年。

sentences.en: And that places a lot of pressure, a lot of expectations on us.
sentences.zh: 这给我们带来了巨大的压力和期望。

sentences.en: And not just straightforward expectations about living up to your parents' dreams for you or taking advantage of opportunities or being successful, but also these expectations
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是达到父母对你的期望、抓住机遇或获得成功这种直截了当的期望，还包括这些期望：

sentences.en: to be doing the most, to be living a fantasy life, to make everybody happy, to constantly be happy yourself.
sentences.zh: 要做最出彩的自己，过着梦幻般的生活，让每个人都开心，自己也要时刻保持快乐。

sentences.en: For a lot of us, that is not the case.
sentences.zh: 对我们很多人来说，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And I think we often feel guilty that perhaps we are wasting what some would call the best years of our lives or that we are passing up privileges that other people would die for.
sentences.zh: 我想我们经常会感到内疚，觉得自己可能在浪费某些人所谓的大好年华，或者我们在错过别人做梦都想得到的特权。

sentences.en: We feel guilty for choosing to rest, then we feel guilty for choosing to go out.
sentences.zh: 我们因为选择休息而感到内疚，然后又因为选择出门而感到内疚。

sentences.en: We feel guilty for spending too much time at work, but also guilty when we're not working.
sentences.zh: 我们因为花太多时间工作而感到内疚，但同时在不工作时又会感到内疚。

sentences.en: Guilty for choosing to prioritize ourselves.
sentences.zh: 为选择优先照顾自己而感到内疚。

sentences.en: Guilty for making mistakes.
sentences.zh: 为犯错误而感到内疚。

sentences.en: That is just one facet.
sentences.zh: 这只是其中一个方面。

sentences.en: But another common aspect has to do with our relationships and our friendships.
sentences.zh: 另一个常见的方面与我们的人际关系和友情有关。

sentences.en: Friendships, I have this belief, are the most important relationship that we have in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 我相信，友情是我们二十多岁时最重要的人际关系。

sentences.en: You know, some of us find partners.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们中的一些人找到了伴侣。

sentences.en: A lot of us are still connected to our family.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人仍然与家人保持着联系。

sentences.en: But the real lifeblood of our 20s, the real people who hold us up, who keep us feeling connected, are our friends.
sentences.zh: 但我们二十多岁时的真正命脉，真正支撑我们、让我们保持联系的人，是我们的朋友。

sentences.en: And with that sense of connection comes a sense of expectation of not wanting to let them down.
sentences.zh: 伴随着这种连接感而来的，是一种不想让他们失望的期望感。

sentences.en: We feel like we need to be more available.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得自己需要随叫随到。

sentences.en: We often encounter a fear of missing out.
sentences.zh: 我们经常会遭遇害怕错过的心理（FOMO）。

sentences.en: But deeper than that, a fear of disappointing people, especially as we slowly become adults and are trying to figure out who we are as individuals,
sentences.zh: 但比这更深层的，是害怕让人失望的恐惧，尤其随着我们慢慢长大成人，努力弄清楚自己作为个体的身份，

sentences.en: trying to find more time for ourselves, working more, investing in our careers, and also trying to maintain those relationships, trying to be a good friend.
sentences.zh: 试图为自己争取更多时间，更多地工作，投入到事业中，同时还要维系这些关系，努力做一个好朋友。

sentences.en: And I think it's in those moments where we experience this intense sense of obligation to other people.
sentences.zh: 我想正是在那些时刻，我们对他人产生了强烈的责任感和义务感。

sentences.en: We cannot always be what others expect us to be.
sentences.zh: 我们不可能永远满足别人对我们的期望。

sentences.en: Sometimes we do the wrong thing because we are still learning, because we are still kind of like, we are baby adults.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们做了错事，是因为我们仍在学习，因为我们有点像那种刚成年的半大不小的人。

sentences.en: And the emotional aftermath of not living up to a sense of expectation or obligation from others is this intense guilt, feeling like you are secretly a bad person.
sentences.zh: 而未能达到他人的期望或义务，其带来的情感后续就是这种强烈的内疚感，觉得自己暗地里是个糟糕的人。

sentences.en: Essentially, guilt is that feeling that you aren't a good person.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，内疚就是觉得自己不是个好人的那种感觉。

sentences.en: And that doesn't actually need to be the truth if you feel that way.
sentences.zh: 如果你有这种感觉，它其实并不一定就是事实。

sentences.en: And I've been thinking about this a lot in my own life recently because chronic guilt is a feeling I experience and I've spent a lot of time attempting to come to terms with.
sentences.zh: 我最近在自己的生活中也经常思考这个问题，因为长期内疚是我本人会有的一种感受，我花了很多时间试图去接受它。

sentences.en: It's one of those kind of mental blocks that I'm constantly trying to work through.
sentences.zh: 这是那种我一直在努力克服的心理障碍之一。

sentences.en: I'm trying to work through these dilemmas where I feel like a bad person for just prioritizing myself.
sentences.zh: 我正试图理清这些困境：仅仅因为把自己的利益放在首位，我就觉得自己是个糟糕的人。

sentences.en: You know, I feel a lot of guilt
sentences.zh: 你知道，我会有很强的内疚感

sentences.en: at not working as hard as I should or taking time off, even when I know I deserve it because I feel like I need to work harder for my opportunities
sentences.zh: 觉得自己没有像应有的那样努力工作，或者在休息时感到内疚，即便我知道自己配得上这些休息，因为我觉得自己需要更努力地工作来换取机会

sentences.en: or that there is a certain standard or quantity of work that I need to do before resting.
sentences.zh: 或者觉得在休息之前，我必须完成某种标准或数量的工作。

sentences.en: And then, of course, there's the guilt of not being a good friend, for saying no to things, for cancelling plans, for not being the same person that I was at 18 or 19
sentences.zh: 然后，当然还有没能当好朋友的内疚，因为对各种事情说不、取消计划、或者无法成为18岁或19岁时的那个自己而感到内疚

sentences.en: who wanted to go out all the time.
sentences.zh: 那个曾经总是想出门的自己。

sentences.en: Guilt that I've changed and that somehow I owe it to other people to stay the same.
sentences.zh: 内疚于自己已经变了，而不知为何，我欠别人一个保持不变的承诺。

sentences.en: And part of my experiences with this emotion has been this underlying sense of blame or responsibility, again, for how others feel.
sentences.zh: 我对这种情绪的体验有一部分来自于这种潜意识里的指责或责任感，同样，是对他人感受的责任感。

sentences.en: And with that a persistent anxiety that someone out there is mad at me.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的便是一种挥之不去的焦虑，总觉得外面的某个人生我的气。

sentences.en: Someone is holding a grudge.
sentences.zh: 某个人还在记恨我。

sentences.en: Someone is upset by something I've done unintentionally, whether it is forgetting to reply to a message or having plans when they ask me if I'm free.
sentences.zh: 某个人对我的无心之举感到不快，不管是忘记回复消息，还是在他们问我有没有空时我正好有安排。

sentences.en: And it's highly senseless and irrational.
sentences.zh: 这完全是毫无意义且不理智的。

sentences.en: And I think a part of our experience of guilt is also quite egotistical.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们体验内疚的一部分原因也相当自负。

sentences.en: I've been thinking about this a lot, but when we are experiencing misplaced chronic guilt, it's often because we are exaggerating the impact of our actions and choices.
sentences.zh: 我一直在深入思考这一点，但当我们经历错位的长期内疚时，通常是因为我们夸大了自己的行为和选择所产生的影响。

sentences.en: We kind of overestimate how much people really care, how much damage we're actually able to do.
sentences.zh: 我们有点高估了别人究竟有多在乎，高估了我们实际上能造成多大的破坏。

sentences.en: There are a myriad, several factors that come into this, including but not limited to perfectionism, people-pleasing tendencies, the childhood guilt wound, anxiety,
sentences.zh: 导致这种情况的因素有很多，包括但不限于完美主义、讨好型人格倾向、童年内疚创伤、焦虑，

sentences.en: sensitivity to criticism.
sentences.zh: 以及对批评的敏感。

sentences.en: And then sometimes there are simply moments when you act in a way that betrays your values.
sentences.zh: 有时候，也确实会有那么一些时刻，你的行为背叛了自己的价值观。

sentences.en: And that's something that we need to come to terms with.
sentences.zh: 而这也是我们需要接受的现实。

sentences.en: So we're going to explore all of that.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来我们将探讨所有这些内容。

sentences.en: We're going to explore the emotional experience of guilt, including how to kind of overcome moments where you feel responsible for something that has happened
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨内疚这种情感体验，包括如何去克服那些当你觉得自己需要对发生的事情负责时的时刻

sentences.en: when it might not actually be your fault.
